details: Live CI-V read aborted with '0.0' is not a valid value for 'rtone' (1.0.60, IC-910H; reporter also has an IC-740). CHIRP's GUI isolates the bad channel; NewChirp's single-pass read stopped. drivers/newchirp_icomciv_tone_compat.py makes non-standard tone values read as 88.5 Hz for every CI-V memory frame.
summary: Read stops on unset CTCSS tone (rtone 0.0)
